# Piano Practice
> A free browser practice tool for piano and violin: open a MIDI or MusicXML file, slow it down, loop any bars, and follow falling notes onto the keys. No install, no account. Built-in duets include Lightly Row, May Song, Long Long Ago, Canon in D, Jingle Bells, and Mariage d'amour. Live at https://hen-ml.github.io/piano/ — source at https://github.com/hen-ml/piano
## Details
- Slow playback to 40-150% tempo, loop any bar range, mute either part to practice your line against the other
- USB MIDI keyboard support (Web MIDI), computer keyboard playing, sampled acoustic piano and violin sounds
- Violin mode labels notes by string and finger (first position)
- Works offline as an installable PWA; nothing is uploaded
